newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares up on foreign buying, more seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares up on foreign buying, more seen.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index rose 0.64 percent on Friday on what traders said was follow-through demand from foreigners.
They expect the market to continue its upward trek.
* The SBI index rose 9.14 points to 1,440.2.
* Pharmaceutical wholesaler Salus was the top gainer, jumping 11.38 percent to 14,490 tolars on volume of 10 shares.
* Trading company Kovinotehna was the most active, jumping 5.83 percent to 436 tolars on volume of 10,320 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
